component.name: YouTube Chat TTS
component.summary: Reads YouTube live chat aloud and mixes the speech into OBS

description.p: YouTube Chat TTS adds a dock to OBS Studio that reads YouTube live chat messages aloud with the bundled offline espeak-ng speech engine and feeds the synthesized speech into OBS as a native audio source. Streams and recordings carry spoken chat like any other audio; no virtual audio cable or cloud speech service is involved.

ul.li: Connect with the official YouTube Data API v3 (API key required) or with the experimental keyless InnerTube provider; Auto mode prefers the official API and falls back to InnerTube when it is unavailable.
Filter messages by length, per-user and global cooldown, command prefix, URLs, blocklisted phrases, Super Chats, new members and moderators.
Choose the espeak-ng voice and adjust rate, pitch, amplitude and output volume while connected.
Add the TTS audio source to the current scene or to all scenes and record it on any OBS audio track.
See connection state, the active provider, the next queued messages and the last 500 log lines in the dock.
Keep settings and the API key in an owner-only (0600) settings file; the key is passed to the helper on stdin and never appears in logs or process arguments.

description.p: First release of the Flatpak extension.

ul.li: YouTube live chat dock with official API and experimental keyless provider modes, including Auto fallback.
Bundled espeak-ng offline speech engine and a native OBS audio source for speech.
Message filtering, bounded queue, live voice and volume controls, and persisted settings.
